# KAPI route registry

Generated from keripy main 7bdf934a5 (2026-10-05), KERI spec fbdd4a6 (2026-08-28) and ACDC spec f0bd097 (2026-08-28). Tiers and conventions are explained in [routes.md](routes.md). *In spec* is a literal search for the route in the specification sources, so it says where a spec mentions a route, not whether the spec makes it normative.
